finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified.

**Final report:**

1. **DONE** — Panels on the provisioned dashboard "Service health" (at `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`): **"Request rate"**, **"Error count"**, **"Latency by endpoint"** (3 panels).

2. **DONE** — New dashboard **"fwgr61-n1 Bench Dashboard"** created and saved, containing a **Stat** panel titled **"fwgr61-n1 Availability"** whose query uses the **TestData** data source (panel rendered a live value, e.g. 35.5). Verified present after page reload.

3. **DONE** — The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled **"fwgr61-n1 Notes"** with content **"Bench notes for run fwgr61-n1"** (includes the runid). Verified present after page reload; "Dashboard saved" alert observed.

4. **DONE** — Dashboard has the tag **`bench`** (verified as a chip in Settings > General > Tags with aria-label `Remove "bench" tag`, and as a tag chip on its row in the Dashboards list). Time range set to **Last 6 hours** and persisted via the save dialog's "Update default time range" checkbox — the saved JSON model contains `"time": {"from": "now-6h", "to": "now"}`, and a fresh reload of the bare URL defaults to Last 6 hours.

5. **DONE** — Auto-refresh interval set to **`1m`** and persisted via the save dialog's "Update default refresh value" checkbox — saved JSON model contains `"refresh": "1m"`, and after a fresh reload the top bar shows 1m (button aria-label: "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected").

6. **DONE** — URL read from the browser address bar: **`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bfyknucqyq0owc/fwgr61-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`** — dashboard UID: **`bfyknucqyq0owc`**.

Note: during the time-range step the agent briefly overwrote the JSON-model viewer's buffer while searching it, but immediately undid the edit and exited without saving, so the stored dashboard was never affected (confirmed by the subsequent saved-state checks).
